title: Audit phase-order bank sharing and repair historical CI replays
body:
For PR2850's producer-first phase-accumulator schedule, returning the bank does not by itself certify the desired data phase. This independent audit gives the exact consumer-order/cross-term criterion and a sharp minimum active-bank-bit count in the explicitly restricted one-assigned-tensor-bit-per-column model. For example, reversed consumers can share one bank bit, while identical producer/consumer order requires separate bits.

The written all-size argument shows that legal bank classes are decreasing subsequences of the consumer permutation. Its longest increasing subsequence is both a lower witness and the number of bits used by the constructive rank assignment. This applies the standard permutation-order partition argument to the predecessor's Pauli boundary; it is not a general bank-dimension theorem or a new combinatorial method.

The scientific result is isolated in `research/phase-order-bank-audit/`. The later CI maintenance commits described below address concrete inherited failures blocking this PR. Base canonical main is `4865c30d0fb12a475bb6eaaca1c781a1592a3811`, priority revision 5; the pre-submission refresh to `d311a18c6061af67d0aa35cbeced605b8b7472ed` left the relevant guidance and selected record unchanged. Exact contribution head: `395b7fbde8f009263c8dceb46e0f2ee8a2a6e846`.

Validation on native Windows CPython 3.12.14:

- Registered replay passes under `-I -O -B`.
- All 5,913 consumer permutations for f<=7; every set partition for f<=5 (6,635 schedule/partition cases), with 153 independently minimized permutations.
- A separate Fraction-valued physical-array implementation checks all 488 joint input columns / 87,104 coefficients in five f<=3 fixtures, including arbitrary bank lanes.
- Ten semantic controls plus relocated Git-free/read-only replay and result/reference-pin corruption rejection.
- 97 repository research-helper tests pass, with 7 platform-specific skips.
- Exact committed-byte preflight and staged whitespace checks pass; working tree is clean.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/phase-order-bank-audit
```

Limitations: the literal unfused schedule retains 4f one-axis C calls before wrappers. This is a count for that schedule, not an implementation lower bound. No encoded/general bank optimum, native invoice recertification, two-parent-level C/Q replay, physical caller admission, selected cold replay, new supplier or kappa improvement is claimed. Predecessor source files are inspected references pinned by commit/blob/SHA-256; they are not imported or reauthenticated remotely by the standalone replay. The two arithmetic implementations belong to this same AI-assisted audit author, with no independent human review or proof assistant.

Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2842#discussioncomment-18964255. This takes the released independent-audit handoff. Complete overlap coverage: 543 open PRs, 2,014 closed/merged PRs and 1,502 Discussion records at the recorded UTC snapshots; not a novelty guarantee.

Credit Gareth Davidson / bitplane's PR2850 at `a007c32f992195ad372806db38c9359dd49382ad` for the exact accumulator contract, original counterexample, working reverse/tensor controls and paid-recursion handoff. Earlier contributor credit remains in the unchanged predecessor. New work by Dennis / antunishdPursuit, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, source inspection, implementation, execution, self-review and writing. Apache-2.0. Selected records and immutable source archives remain unchanged; the CI maintenance below refreshes three derived live receipt bindings.

CI maintenance (scientific package remains unchanged at `395b7fbd`):

- Restore authenticated historical scheduler/HPE/graph helpers only in private replay copies. Retain the original Make/test commands, frozen source manifests/archive bytes, negative controls, and final tracked-byte gates. Keep current optimized production implementations and their live equivalence tests. The current ledger runs with its original per-PR source contexts and a complete authenticated inventory for nested Git-free replays.
- Fetch the three exact Git baselines required by existing performance tests in shallow CI checkouts. Compose already accepted central-factor, mixed-point, Leech and shared-point source-pin updates while preserving full baseline-payload comparisons and changed-source/forged-pin/unknown-field controls.
- Correct the native workflow's literal-plus path glob and Python 3.13+ symlink-cycle detection. Verify source guards against published Git blobs as well as working-copy bytes. Make the ledger regression follow every authoritative review round instead of stopping at efficient1200; retain forged-head rejection.
- Check active and historical records with their own HPE supplement contexts. Active selected-record verification remains strict; historical checks admit only the exact reviewed UTF-8 successor and authenticated original snapshot. Extend complete cold-replay trigger coverage for the explicit archived dependency. Neither selected record nor checkpoint is edited.
- Refresh three stale derived metadata bindings omitted after accepted production replay update `73cc66d0`: `certificate_sha256` in the joint/skip validation receipts and the local replay-source SHA in the pair-frame receipt. A narrow generator admits exact original/regenerated bytes and exact current source/certificate hashes. All mathematical receipt fields and pinned mathematical generators remain unchanged. Complete Linux regeneration and clean-tree gates pass.

Maintenance credit: original graph/audit authors and retained source headers; Wentao Li's preserved baselines and production optimizations; ywz65's UTF-8 successor; Aaron Wang's containment scan; Chafik Boukhalfa's verifier/certificates; existing assertion/scheduler contributors. Adapter and regression changes by Dennis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0. Maintenance blocks are separate commits in the branch history.

Hosted Linux evidence on repair head `186a38eb124bc2fead44ae9d03a6edcf7649c882`:

- [Complete verification matrix](https://github.com/antunishdPursuit/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38855418536): **52/52 jobs pass**. All **153 test modules** pass independently on **Python 3.11, 3.13 and 3.14**, including Linux symlink-cycle controls; all three formal jobs and producer/clone/strip/pair/joint groups pass, with unchanged-tree gates.
- [Exact tooling/current ledger](https://github.com/antunishdPursuit/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38855418321), [reconciliation92](https://github.com/antunishdPursuit/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38855418469), and all six other scoped workflows triggered on this head pass.
- [Repaired native 5/9/11-stage replay](https://github.com/antunishdPursuit/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38854225209) passes at earlier head `9b173438`, with unchanged native inputs. It is not mislabeled as a new-head run.

Local evidence: complete current ledger CLI audit (2,356 PR records, nested historical tree audits and final byte gate); 27 historical replay tests, 38 reconciliation tests, 13 isolated-runner tests, 6 selected-result tests, 21 selected-input tests, 13 composed-pin/digest/packing tests and 4 receipt transition/rejection controls. Normal/optimized-parent coverage is recorded in the relevant commits. Official actionlint v1.7.12 passes all four changed workflows; exact eight-file scientific package commit-byte preflight passes on the published head. Windows symlink tests skip when creation is unavailable; the actual Linux controls above pass.

Remaining limits: canonical repository checks are still queued/pending, including [the current registered-package run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38855422648). Fork passes do not imply canonical CI or maintainer approval. Fork registered-package dispatch is unavailable because its stale default branch does not register that newer workflow; no default-branch changes were made. No full selected cold replay or full multiplication-theorem verification is claimed.

Canonical main refreshed to `a64a6866909ffa5b51cf00f383222d82b0279cbd`; relevant guidance/priority revision 5/selected records/affected implementation inputs remain unchanged. Read-only merge-tree compatibility succeeds; no merge was performed. CI coordination and concrete source-input handoff supporting PR2361: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2732#discussioncomment-18964462. Its affected-input architecture is separate and not duplicated here.
